# Lunacy

> A collaborative design tool with built-in graphics, offline mode, and private cloud options. Runs on Windows, MacOS, and Linux.


## Docs

- [About Lunacy](https://lunacy.docs.icons8.com/about-lunacy/): Basic information about Lunacy.
- [System Requirements](https://lunacy.docs.icons8.com/system-requirements/): Lunacy hardware and software requirements.
- [Interface](https://lunacy.docs.icons8.com/interface/): Explore the Lunacy interface.
- [Basics](https://lunacy.docs.icons8.com/basics/): An overview of Lunacy's basic features and capabilities.
- [Cloud Documents](https://lunacy.docs.icons8.com/cloud-documents/): Learn how to work with cloud documents.
- [Private Cloud](https://lunacy.docs.icons8.com/private-cloud/): How to collaborate in total privacy.
- [Tools](https://lunacy.docs.icons8.com/tools/): Tools and controls on the Lunacy toolbar.
- [Layers](https://lunacy.docs.icons8.com/layers/): Learn about basic operations with layers in Lunacy.
- [Editing Shapes](https://lunacy.docs.icons8.com/editing-shapes/): Comprehensive guide to working with shapes in Lunacy.
- [Text](https://lunacy.docs.icons8.com/text/): Learn how to work with text in Lunacy.
- [Styling](https://lunacy.docs.icons8.com/styling/): Tools to help you create your unique style.
- [Images](https://lunacy.docs.icons8.com/images/): Learn how to work with images in Lunacy.
- [Built-in Graphics](https://lunacy.docs.icons8.com/built-in-graphics/): Utilize built-in icons, photos, images, and UI kits.
- [Layer and Text Styles](https://lunacy.docs.icons8.com/layer-and-text-styles/): Speed up your work with layer and text styles.
- [Color Variables](https://lunacy.docs.icons8.com/color-variables/): How to create and manage color variables.
- [Components](https://lunacy.docs.icons8.com/components/): Enhance your design workflow by learning how to use components.
- [Shared Libraries](https://lunacy.docs.icons8.com/shared-libraries/): How to reuse components and styles from other files.
- [Auto Layout](https://lunacy.docs.icons8.com/auto-layout/): Create dynamic designs with auto layout.
- [Export](https://lunacy.docs.icons8.com/export/): All you need to know about exporting in Lunacy.
- [Prototyping](https://lunacy.docs.icons8.com/prototyping/): Build prototypes in Lunacy.
- [Linked Design](https://lunacy.docs.icons8.com/linked-design/): How to update live webpages directly from Lunacy.
- [Teams](https://lunacy.docs.icons8.com/teams/): How to collaborate in Lunacy and organize teamwork effectively.
- [Comments](https://lunacy.docs.icons8.com/comments/): How to make notes to designs, provide feedback, and share ideas with your teammates.
- [Tips and Tricks](https://lunacy.docs.icons8.com/tips/): Tips and tricks to help you work in Lunacy faster and more effectively.
- [Shortcuts](https://lunacy.docs.icons8.com/shortcuts/): Speed up your workflow by learning Lunacy's shortcuts.
- [FAQ](https://lunacy.docs.icons8.com/faq/): Frequently asked questions about Lunacy.
- [Release History](https://lunacy.docs.icons8.com/release-history/): New features and fixes for each version of Lunacy.
- [Free Format](https://lunacy.docs.icons8.com/free-format/): Details of the .free format for developers.
